text:
maria: Quick sync on SI co-sell handoff — want a minimal playbook covering marketplace leads, HW partner intros, and joint announcements. keep it pilot-ready.

aj: tl;dr for AEs? what's different tomorrow?

maria: TL;DR: 48h claim window for SI when intake shows SI-referral; else AE auto-claims after 48h. Marketplace leads default to marketplace intake unless explicitly tagged SI-referral. HW partner leads go to SI if SI introduced before PoC.

kevin: practical example: Concert SI runs a workshop and drops a marketplace lead. How should SFDC look?

maria: pseudo-rule: if lead.source=="marketplace" and lead.referrer_type=="SI" then owner=SI_partner (claimable); elif lead.source=="hardware_partner" and SI_intro_stage>="PoC" then owner=SI_partner; else AE auto-claim after 48h. log a note: "si_claimed:<partner_name>" when accepted.

sylvie: Joint announce ops: Redwood owns public press + blog template; SI may co-author and runs customer comms. submit PR draft 5 business days before publish for legal/comms review.

aj: SLA ask: how long for SI to claim and respond?

maria: Claim window = 48 hours. First-reach SLA = 5 business days. If missed, AE outreach template triggers and revops dashboard flags it.

orch-bot: FYI intake-rule v1.4 rolled to staging. Duplicate-detection enabled.

kevin: Enterprise exceptions? >$1M needs different flow.

maria: Governance: deals >$1M require AE lead + Partner Lead + RevOps signoff to transfer full ownership. add checkbox "high_value" on intake form.

revops: I'll add SFDC validation to require partner_name when tag starts with "si_claimed:" and publish a dashboard for unclaimed marketplace leads >72h. ETA next Wed.

sylvie: I'll prepare three email templates (intro, demo logistics, follow-up) and a joint-demo kit checklist for SIs. share edit access with top 10 SI PMs.

kevin: Also building a short HW-demo runbook (lab access, image/AMI, P0 testcases). will link in templates.

maria: Action items: kevin update SFDC tag + automation (due Fri); aj update AE playbook w/ 48h rule + exception flow (due Tue); sylvie publish templates + PR checklist (due Thu); revops add validation + dashboard (due next Wed).

aj: I'll loop in legal for joint-announce NDA language and a one-pager for AEs.

maria: Pilot plan: 2-week pilot with Concert SI (gold) + one hardware partner. measure claimed_rate, time_to_first_contact, duplicate_rate. we'll iterate after metrics. :rocket:
